summary: The capture retry path in beginCaptureAttempt rewrote the durable provider request id by appending "-retry", minting a new provider identity. The provider therefore saw a fresh capture against an already-captured order and definitively refused it, leaving provider funds captured (CAP-SCRIPT-0001) while the local order stayed APPROVED. The fix removes the id mutation so a retry re-sends the original request id verbatim, which the provider recognizes as an idempotent replay and returns the original completed capture for, allowing captureEvidence to seal CAPTURED_VERIFIED.

edits.rationale: Removing the in-memory request-id rewrite makes the retry a true same-id replay of the durable operation identity, so the provider returns the original applied capture instead of refusing a new capture request. This restores the durable-before-outbound identity invariant (the sent id equals the persisted id) and lets the existing captureEvidence path seal the already-applied capture as CAPTURED_VERIFIED rather than leaving a split-brain APPROVED state.
